name: parallax-3d
title: PARALLAX-3D — a WebGL-free ray-traced 3D renderer
description: Build PARALLAX-3D: a TypeScript ray tracer (no GPU API) that renders a 3D scene of spheres and a checkered floor with diffuse+specular lighting and reflections, writing the result to both an HTML canvas and a PPM file from node. Running the node entrypoint must produce output.ppm (a valid non-empty PPM), proving the render works headlessly.
context: Pure software ray tracer. Camera at (0,1,3) looking at origin. Scene: floor at y=-1 (checker), spheres (0,0,0,r=1), (2,0.5,0,r=0.5) with different colors. Simple Lambert + Blinn specular + one soft shadow ray + one reflection bounce, max 2 levels. Viewport 64x64 for the headless entry (fast), 512x512 for the canvas. Write PPM (P3) in main.ts via node. package.json: 'build': 'tsc', 'start': 'node dist/main.js'. Output file PATH: dist/output.ppm.

manifest.purpose: strict TS, outDir dist, ES2020, module commonjs
sphere + floor primitives, intersect, shade, recursion

criteria: runs:sh -c "cd /home/rox/work/parallax-3d && npm install --silent && npx tsc && node dist/main.js && test -s dist/output.ppm && head -1 dist/output.ppm | grep -q P3 && echo PARALLAX:PASS"
